on: Behind the counter. Make each cup the ticket shows.

receipt.title: Coffee Cup receipt
receipt.none: No cups went out this shift, so no tips.
receipt.capped: Cups went out, but today’s tips were all earned. They still count for work XP.
receipt.wrong: Every cup missed the green band, so no tips this shift.

idle: Nobody is waiting yet. The counter is open.
front: Bean’s coffee kiosk. Ask Bean for a job to serve coffee here for tips.

perfect: Spot on at every step. That cup tips more.
Every step in the middle of the green band: a bigger tip.
Spot on. The middle of the green band tips best.
Right in the middle, every step. A bigger tip for it.
fine: A good cup. Stop in the middle of the green band for a bigger tip.
Served, with a small tip. The middle of the green band tips more.
A good cup. Dead centre on each green band earns more.
Good enough for a small tip. Aim for the middle of the green band.
wrong: A step missed the green band. They take it, but leave no tip.
Not quite right. They take the cup, but leave no tip.
That one missed the green band, so no tip for it.
Outside the green band: they take it without a tip.

left: Somebody got tired of waiting and walked off without a cup.

rush.on: A rush: customers back to back. Serve every one for extra work XP.
rush.done: Every one served: extra work XP for the rush.

special: A special order: a syrup step on top, and a better tip for it.
tipsAll: That’s today’s tips all earned. Cups still count for work XP.
far: Walk right up to the Coffee Cup’s window, then try again.
